request_summary: Clean the two FDR e2e planning documents of gaps and doubts not needed by the two main flows into separate v2 files, cross-check the existing UC drafts against them and create v2 UCs where the cuts affect them.

actions.description: Re-read the orchestrator persona, operations workflow, session routing and scoped ACE instructions. Confirmed the branch remained PQ-827-fdr-e2e-test-design and that the pre-existing deletions, untracked sources and earlier drafts were preserved. The work stayed on planning documents and UC drafts: no feature files, code, tests or service calls.

Read both v1 planning documents, both v1 UC drafts, the supplied UC template and the UC workflow conventions. Fixed the cut criterion: keep what the success path of each UC needs; remove alternatives, exceptions other than the propagation failure, extensions, data variants that depended on open questions, and the gaps and doubts that existed only for them.

Created docs/fdr-e2e-ibrido-01-razionale-uc-v2.md and docs/fdr-e2e-ibrido-02-dati-tecnici-v2.md as separate files with stable identifiers: kept QF-03, QF-06 and QF-11 and the DM items needed by the main flows, merged DM-15 into DM-03; 48 v1 identifiers, DM-15 included, are no longer defined. The v1 documents were not modified.

Statically verified both v2 documents: relative links resolve, section references match headings, table column counts are consistent, no dangling reference to a removed identifier, no identifier absent from v1, and a line diff against v1 shows only the intended edits. A first run reported false positives caused by wrong patterns; the patterns were fixed and the check was rerun.

Assessed the impact of the cuts on the v1 UCs and created docs/use-cases/UC-FDR-001-v2.md and UC-FDR-002-v2.md using the supplied template exactly: three header fields, six sections, Nessuno for empty alternative flows, sequential identifiers. Validated the skeleton against the template block, the flow references, the source identifiers and the links with a script, and diffed both files against v1.

Assessed README impact for the four new documents: the README does not reference the FDR e2e documents or the FDR UC drafts and no command, configuration or behaviour changed, so no README update is needed.

outcome.detail: Four new untracked documents were created and statically checked as listed in the actions; the v1 documents were left unchanged. The v2 UCs drop AF, EF and AC items that depended on removed scope. QF-03, QF-06 and QF-11 and the JTBD placeholder remain open. No test, service call, commit or push occurred.

notes: Only qa-orchestrator participated: UC drafting is outside the QA-analyst skills, as for the original drafts, and no delegation was needed. Earlier read-only analysis exchanges in the same conversation (reuse of fdr3 code, publication path, implementation gaps, cross-check of the documents, functional gaps) were not traced because the human had instructed no modifications at that point; this trace does not cover them.

friction.description: A search tool call failed at the start of the turn because that tool does not exist in this execution context; searches were redone with PowerShell Select-String.

The first static validation of the v2 documents flagged retained identifiers because the removed-identifier pattern and the definition pattern were wrong; both patterns were corrected and the check rerun before relying on it.
